workload: 40 visible Small buttons in ten rows. All labels alternate between A and B on each app frame callback, followed by measurements after two seconds of warmup.

android.candidate: Reuse the Compose capsule and fixed PaddingValues, reading theme colors only for visible plain labels.
android.decision: Restored the original primitive. The short comparison showed more CPU and slower completed-frame cadence with the candidate. Host builds overlapped the extended samples, so the size of any runtime effect is uncertain.
android.notes: Process CPU includes the app driver. PSS samples are not object-retention evidence. Completed-frame cadence is calculated from the recent valid gfxinfo frame records, not the full sampling window.

ios.notes: The native SwiftUI Button and its existing Nexa bounds probe and style are present. CADisplayLink measures callback cadence.
